7: The patient's symptoms such as morning stiffness, joint tenderness, and bilateral sacroiliitis are more indicative of Juvenile Idiopathic Arthritis. Laboratory findings like leukopenia, microcytic anemia, elevated C-reactive protein, and erythrocyte sedimentation rate also support this diagnosis.
